segments.exact:
Atlas rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on. A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.
segments.note: Quinton announces/institutes the monthly cadence as a settled decision, then justifies it with an assertive claim; kept as one move since the second sentence supports the same directive-declarative act rather than making an independent claim.
Restates the decision's cadence as a recorded fact in the key-decisions list.
Records ownership assignment in the key-decisions list.
